A '''gill-flush''' was a service provided in [[resort]]s and spas. The procedure employed a device that would dispense a cleansing rinse to the affected branchial area of any number of [[Fish/Legends|piscine]] or [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] life forms.<ref name="HSLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>
